ValidationRule.description: If the user lacks an API key, prevent them from deploying the user story.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( AND(PRIORVALUE( copado__Promote_and_Deploy__c ) = false, copado__Promote_and_Deploy__c = true) , AND(PRIORVALUE( copado__Promote_Change__c ) = false, copado__Promote_Change__c = true) ) , OR( ISBLANK($Setup.copado__Personal_Settings__c.copado__API_Key__c), NOT($Setup.copado__Personal_Settings__c.copado__Disable_Auto_Resolve__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: API Key is not Created. You can create your dedicated API Key from Account Summary App from App Launcher or ensure that Disable Auto-Merge is set to true for your user. If you need assistance, please contact the DevOps team.
